definitions.explanation: A ball of ground meat mixed with seasonings and other ingredients, then cooked by boiling, frying, or steaming. A common item in home cooking and bento boxes.

examples.japanese: {肉団子|にくだんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肉団子|にくだんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{甘酢|あまず}→甘酢：14851_amazu⟧あん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put meatballs in sweet-and-sour sauce in the bento.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肉団子|にくだんご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧、⟦{煮込|にこ}み→煮込み：19761_nikomi⟧⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I put meatballs and vegetables in a pot and made a simmered soup.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat) and ⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧ (dumpling, ball). Refers to the Western-style meatball as adapted in Japanese cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉団子|にくだんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{甘酢|あまず}→甘酢：14851_amazu⟧あん (meatballs in sweet-and-sour sauce)
- {肉団子|にくだんご}⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧ (meatball soup)
- {肉団子|にくだんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸|まる}める→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧ (roll meatballs)

A staple of Japanese home cooking and a popular bento item, especially for children. Often made with ⟦{豚|ぶた}ひき{肉|にく}→豚ひき肉：23445_butahikiniku⟧ (ground pork) or a mix of pork and chicken. The sweet-and-sour version (⟦{甘酢|あまず}→甘酢：14851_amazu⟧あんかけ) is one of the most common preparations.

COUNTER: ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧
